# Run book: Load a file into a table

[Run books](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/load-a-file-into-a-table.md) | [Spec](../specs/load-a-file-into-a-table.md)

## Contents

- [Purpose](#purpose)

## Purpose

Show the read, key check and store steps with a report of what was written, skipped or rejected.

## Preconditions

- The signed-in user holds the data.load right (the admin role).

## Verify

Automatically: `npx playwright test e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g "Load a file into a table"` (add `E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8088` to run against the compose stack).

By hand, in the example web application at `/data/load`:

1. **Load the sample.** The sample CSV has a repeated id; press Load. Expect: The report shows 3 rows read, 2 written and 1 skipped, and the stored rows are listed.

## Troubleshooting

**Table 1 — Known problems**

| Symptom | Likely cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Load refused | The text is empty, too long, the key column is blank or the format is unknown | Paste CSV or JSON text under 100000 characters and name the key column |
| Forbidden | The user lacks the data.load right | Sign in with the admin role |

Related framework features: OoBDev.DataLoader (`ILoader`, `CsvRowReader`, `InMemoryRowSink`).
